rationale: ProspectsIndex remains the cohesive list presentation and URL interaction owner for filters, counts, cards and creation/pipeline dialogs. A single successful-current-read data gate governs every data-backed branch, using existing TanStack isFetchedAfterMount semantics. The one effect synchronizes failed-current-read state with the existing new/pipeline URL intents, preserving filters and unmounting stale child editor state. The prospect query hook remains the canonical request owner: its local staleTime0 ensures a new read on mount/filter selection instead of restoring a fresh-but-older cached filter after a denial. No new cache framework, backend authority, mutation dispatch or shared policy is introduced. Keeping this189-line composition together makes every branch auditable against the same current-data invariant; arbitrary extraction would obscure it. Error copy/retry remain QueryState; modal internals remain ProspectEditor/ProspectPipeline.
scopeLimits: The Portfolio browser fixture has a canonical DataProvider but not the complete ApplicationBoundary. The client test proves actual navigation to another client route discards the editor and re-entry after failed current read remains closed; it does not independently qualify live session/client authorization.
tests: Twelve new browser cases cover failed remount/filter reads, fresh cached-filter return after403/503, open creation/pipeline-stage editors, held authorized retry, client route replacement and preservation of typed input on successful same-key background refresh. Existing fixture and public query semantics are reused.
